items.name: THE PINTA ISLAND TORTOISE
items.image_alt: Monochrome illustration of a saddle-backed Pinta Island giant tortoise in volcanic habitat
items.epitaph: An entire lineage ended with one old tortoise called Lonesome George.
items.why: Centuries of hunting and introduced goats devastated the isolated Pinta population and its habitat.
items.afterlife: George remains a conservation symbol, while related hybrids may help restore parts of the lost lineage.
items.note: Lonesome George, the last known pure Pinta Island tortoise, died on 24 June 2012. Related hybrids retain some Pinta ancestry, so the subject remains the extinct pure lineage.
